title: ModuleTaskCodexProfileAdapter
responsibility: Construct and validate native Codex permission profiles for isolated task tools.

inputs.name: prepare.input
inputs.description: Validated source, exact assigned files, readonly contract snapshot and sealed CLI, private scratch, and Codex exec argv.

outputs.name: prepare
outputs.description: Resolved trusted Codex executable with requested exact-file, scratch and read-only runtime grants, denied tool network and inherited token environment, and disabled plugins, apps, agents and approvals. Native runtime defaults may grant more access than those requested rules: the pinned macOS Codex 0.154.0 permits shared temporary paths despite explicit denial, and a 0.164.0 probe also permitted application-directory reads. Profile construction does not authorize a launch or prove credential isolation. A trusted host must independently qualify the complete tool and filesystem boundary; reject project config or rules that neutral cwd cannot honor.

errors.name: unsafe or unverifiable isolation
errors.description: Reject non-Codex argv, unsupported host/runtime, unsafe paths, secret-bearing grants or untrusted/symlink/hardlink scopes; never fall back unrestricted.

errors.name: invalid configuration
errors.description: A null constructor configuration cannot supply the fields read by instance methods.

test.title: ModuleTaskCodexProfileAdapter.connect from default initialization returns the file name
ModuleTaskCodexProfileAdapter.connect from custom initialization returns the configured name
ModuleTaskCodexProfileAdapter.prepare from default initialization validates a native profile
ModuleTaskCodexProfileAdapter.prepare admits exact native permissions and rejects unsafe scopes
